<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_angular_provider"><sp_angular_provider action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><name>DHAPIService</name><script><![CDATA[function DHAPIService(DHApi, DHDevice) {
	const api = DHApi("v2");
	const state = {
		dex_score: null,
		selectedAsset: null,
		assetsLoading: null,
		assetDetails: null,
	};

	Object.seal(state);

	this.state = state;

	this.setSelectedAsset = function (assetID) {
		state.selectedAsset = assetID;
	};

	this.getSelectedAssetInfo = function () {

		if(!state.selectedAsset || !state.assetDetails) return null;

		return state.assetDetails[state.selectedAsset] || null;
	};

	/**
   * Retrieve the DEX scores for a user
   * @returns {Promise}
   */
	this.getDexScores = async function getDexScores() {
		if (state.dex_score) return state.dex_score;

		return state.dex_score = await api.getDexScores();
	};

	/**
   * @param {array} devices - array of objects with CI name and related asset sys ID
   */
	this.getMetrics = async function getMetrics() {
		console.time("getMetrics");
		state.assetsLoading = true;
		state.assetDetails = null;

		let assetMap = {};
		let firstAsset = null;

		try {
			const r = await api.getDeviceMetrics();

			r.data.data.forEach((deviceData) => {
				//created Devices
				const device = new DHDevice(deviceData);
				assetMap[deviceData.asset_id] = device

				if (!deviceData.error && !firstAsset) firstAsset = deviceData.asset_id;

				// Extract values once
				const statuses = device.metrics
				.filter(m => m.category === "Performance")
				.map(m => m.value);

				// Determine score based on precedence
				let score = "good";
				if (statuses.includes("poor")) {
					score = "poor";
				} else if (statuses.includes("average")) {
					score = "average";
				}

				device.update({ "overall_score": score });
			});

			const asset_ids = Object.keys(assetMap);

			state.selectedAsset = firstAsset || asset_ids[0] || null;
			state.assetDetails = assetMap;
			state.assetsLoading = false;
		} catch (err) {
			console.error(err);
		}

		return state.assetDetails;
	};

	/**
   * Retrieve the DEX scores for a user
   * @returns {Promise}
   */
	this.getDexScores = async function getDexScores() {
		if (state.dex_score) return state.dex_score;

		state.dex_score = await api.getDexScores();

		return state.dex_score;
	};

	/**
   * @param {array} scores - array of objects with dates
   * @param {bool} desc - sort descending?
   */
	this.sortScoresByDate = function sortScoresByDate(scores, desc) {
		return scores.sort((a, b) => {
			// Parse the date strings into Date objects
			let dateA = new Date(a.date);
			let dateB = new Date(b.date);

			// Compare the Date objects
			return desc ? dateB - dateA : dateA - dateB;
		});
	};
}
]]></script><sys_class_name>sp_angular_provider</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>peter.watt</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-07-22 13:48:29</sys_created_on><sys_customer_update>false</sys_customer_update><sys_id>2b3a8fec9316c3906214fe327cba105b</sys_id><sys_mod_count>2</sys_mod_count><sys_name>DHAPIService</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Actionable Eco Device Health" source="x_mukl_dh">9acc633393ca8f506214fe327cba10bf</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_replace_on_upgrade>false</sys_replace_on_upgrade><sys_scope display_value="Actionable Eco Device Health">9acc633393ca8f506214fe327cba10bf</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sp_angular_provider_2b3a8fec9316c3906214fe327cba105b</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>peter.watt</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-07-22 14:17:59</sys_updated_on><type>service</type></sp_angular_provider></record_update>
